status: registered before any valid natural-use telemetry record
observed_implementation_failure: The bundled local-15M TinyStories model returned plain punctuation and emitted no tool-call JSON. It is not a viable OS planner for this study.
changes: A deterministic common-OS intent adapter maps bounded read, list, status, note and configuration-removal requests to canonical tool calls.
Every mapped call still traverses the frozen learned world-model preview, deterministic rule backstop, confirmation policy, capability check, executor and verifier.
Each disposable disk receives a fixed non-sensitive README fixture and an empty /tmp directory so the frozen requests address real resources.
A visible guest pointer click transfers physical keyboard ownership to the desktop before registered prompts begin.
unchanged: all 24 frozen prompt texts and their order
all quantitative gates and privacy boundaries
no synthetic collection hook or direct execute_tool JSON-RPC
no physical actuation and unchanged source disk

diagnostic_goals: one frozen prompt used only to confirm the UI routing failure

claim_boundary: The amended study measures natural UI text reaching a deterministic intent adapter and then the JEPA safety runtime. It is not evidence that the bundled language model learned OS planning or that intent parsing is learned.
